topic.title: Equivalent fractions
topic.overview: Equivalent fractions are fractions that represent the same value or proportion, even if their numerators and denominators are different. They can be found by multiplying or dividing both the numerator and denominator of a fraction by the same nonzero number. Changing only the numerator or only the denominator usually changes the value of the fraction. A fraction itself denotes a ratio of the numerator to the denominator.
